item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a product shot for me. I've been thinking about how to present this and am probably overthinking it a little. The product is a scented candle, which is the thing I want the shot to feature. I want it to look premium.

dialog.agent:
A premium candle shot sounds great—simple styling and beautiful lighting can do a lot.

Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?

If you have a photo of your candle, upload it so I can feature your actual product.
dialog.why: It asks where the candle shot will be posted and requests a product photo, waiting for user input.
dialog.user: The platform and aspect ratio are your call, so feel free to choose whatever works best for the product shot. You can also decide the candle container, palette, setting, and lighting. I’m probably overthinking the presentation a little; the main thing is for the scented candle to look premium.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the shot because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

The concept is ready: **smoked amber glass, ivory wax, a limestone pedestal, and soft directional light** for a warm, premium fragrance-campaign look. Once credits are available, I can generate it.

style.prompt: Premium editorial studio product photograph of a single scented candle as the unmistakable hero. Substantial smoked amber glass vessel with refined clean cylindrical silhouette, creamy ivory wax and a small elegant burning flame. Candle on a warm limestone plinth, seamless warm taupe background, restrained amber, ivory and sand palette. Soft directional window light from the upper left, rich delicate shadows, subtle glass reflections, beautifully detailed wax and stone textures. Sophisticated luxury fragrance campaign, photorealistic, immaculate styling, ample negative space within a wide composition, candle prominently framed, shallow depth of field but entire candle crisp. No typography or added graphic overlays.
